trims: Vehicles with a 3.3L or 3.8L V6 included in recall 04V-386; verify by VIN
after.title: Upper Power-Steering Cooler Hose Can Split and Leak (Recall 04V-386)
after.description: NHTSA recall 04V-386 covers certain 2002-2004 Dodge Grand Caravan minivans with 3.3L or 3.8L engines. The upper power-steering cooler hose can split and leak fluid; leaked fluid can ignite if it reaches an ignition source under the hood.
after.solution: Check the VIN for recall 04V-386. DaimlerChrysler's remedy is replacement of the upper power-steering cooler hose. Do not assume pump whine proves this hose defect; inspect the steering-fluid level and leak source and handle any fire evidence as urgent.
symptoms: Under-hood smoke or fire may occur if fluid reaches an ignition source

NHTSA Investigation PE21-016 Closing Resume - Sliding Doors Inoperative

trims: Vehicles built May 1, 2015-January 9, 2017 with power locks (JPB) and X98 coverage; verify by VIN
after.title: Sliding-Door Locks Can Buzz or Stop Working (X98 Warranty Extension)
after.description: FCA TSB 23-036-21 covers certain 2015-2017 Dodge Grand Caravan vehicles with power locks. A sliding-door lock actuator can emit a loud buzzing sound or stop locking and unlocking. FCA states the door can still be manually locked or unlocked for this bulletin condition.
after.solution: Check DealerCONNECT or the VIN for X98 coverage and confirm the exact lock symptom. FCA directs replacement of the affected left or right sliding-door lock actuator when necessary under the warranty extension; diagnose a door that cannot be opened manually as a different or additional condition.
symptoms: One or both sliding-door power locks do not function
Loud buzzing during lock or unlock operation
Door does not power-lock or power-unlock
